news.headline: TCG Crossover and Invus Public Equities Disclose Large Passive Stakes in Abivax
news.summary: TCG Crossover funds (led by Chen Yu) disclosed an aggregate ~7.0% passive stake (about 6.0M ADSs) in Abivax, while Invus Public Equities separately disclosed a roughly 5% stake, underscoring continued large institutional/crossover investor interest in the stock.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: The FDA gave constructive feedback and aligned with Abivax on its NDA submission strategy, content and format for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis, keeping the company on track to file its first NDA by the end of 2026.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Raises Abivax Price Target to $180, Maintains Overweight
news.summary: Morgan Stanley lifted its price target on ABVX to $180 from $132 while reiterating an Overweight rating, citing the strengthened ABTECT maintenance safety data and positive FDA pre-NDA interaction.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax hired four senior commercial leaders from Amgen, Takeda, AbbVie and Eli Lilly with track records on blockbuster brands (e.g., Entyvio, Humira), building out launch-readiness ahead of a planned U.S. obefazimod commercialization.

news.headline: Abivax Reportedly Re-engages Centerview Amid Renewed Big Pharma Takeover Interest
news.summary: French outlet La Lettre reported that Abivax re-engaged investment bank Centerview for renewed takeover discussions with large pharmaceutical companies, keeping acquisition speculation alive alongside the company's own commercialization buildout.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Closing of $920 Million Public Offering
news.summary: Abivax closed its upsized ADS offering at $920.0 million gross proceeds (underwriters' over-allotment fully exercised), extending its cash runway into Q4 2029 to fund a potential solo U.S. launch of obefazimod.

catalysts.label: FDA NDA submission for obefazimod (ulcerative colitis)
catalysts.detail: Abivax reaffirmed after its July 30, 2026 positive pre-NDA FDA meeting that it remains on track to submit its first NDA for obefazimod in moderately to severely active UC by the end of 2026.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Per Abivax's investor-relations financial calendar, half-year 2026 financial results and a business update are scheduled for September 21, 2026.

catalysts.label: EMA MAA filing for obefazimod
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for filing a Marketing Authorisation Application with the European Medicines Agency for obefazimod in UC in the second half of 2026.

catalysts.label: Lead combination-therapy candidate selection
catalysts.detail: Abivax has guided to selecting a lead combination-therapy candidate (obefazimod paired with another mechanism) by year-end 2026 as part of its lifecycle strategy.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b Crohn's disease 12-week induction data
catalysts.detail: Topline 12-week induction results from the Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD trial of obefazimod in moderately to severely active Crohn's disease are expected around mid-2027.

catalysts.label: Takeover / partnership speculation
catalysts.detail: Persistent, unconfirmed press reports (e.g., La Lettre) of Big Pharma acquisition interest (including past Eli Lilly speculation) continue, with Abivax reportedly having re-engaged Centerview in July 2026; management maintains the $920M raise lets it pursue a solo U.S. launch instead of relying on a deal.

pulse: Abivax enters the ABTECT-driven ulcerative colitis launch runway well-capitalized ($920M raised in July) and de-risked on safety, having cleared a positive pre-NDA FDA interaction (July 30) and built out a commercial leadership team from Amgen, Takeda, AbbVie and Lilly veterans ahead of a planned Q4 2026 NDA filing. Large crossover/institutional holders (TCG Crossover, Invus) continue to disclose sizable passive stakes, and Wall Street sentiment remains strongly bullish (Morgan Stanley PT $180) even as recurring, unconfirmed takeover chatter (Centerview re-engagement per La Lettre) keeps speculative upside in play. No further material company-specific news broke between August 14 and August 27, 2026 beyond routine SEC/AMF filings; the next hard catalyst is the September 21 H1 2026 results update.
